note.question: How may the presence of informed customers increase the equilibrium prices and profits of both firms?
note.overview: Facing purchase choice involving ambiguity in product quality, consumers behave in a boundedly rational manner. Consumers also exhibit varying degrees of predisposition toward a product. We present a simple model of boundedly rational choice under ambiguity.
